verdict.rationale: Anytype exposes a local API, a headless CLI server, and an MCP/agent-skill integration that let external AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) read/write and run scripts against Anytype data programmatically, which is a foundation for automation. However, there is no evidence of a native scheduler, trigger system, or truly autonomous background execution inside Anytype itself — automations appear to require an external agent tool to be invoked. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/triggers, evidence of unattended background runs without an external agent invoking them, independent confirmation of autonomous operation.
